text:
Opinions are divided as to whether people should buy environmentally friendly products or choose cheaper alternatives. This essay will consider both perspectives before explaining my own opinion.

On the one hand, supporters of green products argue that environmentally friendly products reduce harm and often save money over time. They use less energy, create less waste and are often more durable, and growing demand encourages companies to improve their methods. An efficient light bulb, for example, may cost more at first but lasts much longer and uses far less electricity. Buyers who choose such goods also send a clear signal to manufacturers that the market wants cleaner production. If enough people do this, prices tend to fall and green options become normal.

On the other hand, others point out that many households simply cannot afford to pay extra for green products. When budgets are tight, families have to choose the cheapest option, and for people on low incomes the price on the label matters more than long-term benefits. Some products labelled green make claims that are exaggerated or hard to check, so shoppers may pay more without any real gain for the environment. Cheap alternatives therefore remain popular unless prices fall or rules improve. A parent who is buying clothes and food for a family of five, for instance, cannot always choose the more expensive version. In such cases, affordable green options are far more helpful than moral pressure.

In conclusion, both views have merit. Personally, I believe that people should choose green products where they can afford them, while governments should make them cheaper through taxes and clear labelling so that the choice becomes easier for everyone.

plan.think: Mở bài giữ đúng hai lựa chọn của đề (environmentally friendly / cheaper); mỗi thân bài một phía; ý kiến riêng tách ra: chọn xanh khi đủ khả năng, chính phủ giúp hạ giá.
Dùng ít năng lượng, ít rác, bền hơn; nhu cầu tăng thúc ép doanh nghiệp cải thiện. Ví dụ bóng đèn tiết kiệm điện đắt hơn ban đầu nhưng dùng lâu. Nếu nhiều người chọn, giá giảm.

Nhiều hộ không đủ khả năng trả thêm; ngân sách hạn chế thì giá ghi trên nhãn quan trọng hơn lợi ích dài hạn; một số nhãn xanh phóng đại. Ví dụ phụ huynh mua quần áo và thực phẩm cho gia đình năm người.
Chọn xanh khi có thể, chính phủ giúp qua thuế và nhãn rõ ràng.
